area.scope.heading: The same repair costs differently in a frame house, a new build and a two-flat
area.scope.1.why: Bigger new builds often run a furnace and condenser for each floor, so one call can mean two systems to check.
area.scope.2.why: Newer furnaces vent through plastic pipe to the side wall. Their sensors, igniters and drain lines are a job of their own.
area.scope.3.why: Older frame houses near St. Mary of the Angels and Bucktown two-flats can still heat with a boiler and radiators.
area.scope.4.why: Narrow lots put condensers on roof decks and garage roofs, so getting to them sets the time on site.
area.scope.5.why: Restaurants and boutiques on Damen and North run rooftop units and make-up air, booked around opening hours.
area.scope.6.why: The biggest swing of all. Where the unit has years left, we say so.

area.buildings.heading: What heats and cools your Bucktown building
area.buildings.1.title: Frame house
area.buildings.1.body: A furnace in the basement, or an older boiler and radiators. Central air was usually added later.
area.buildings.2.title: Single-family new build
area.buildings.2.body: High-efficiency furnaces and central air, often one system per floor, with condensers on the roof deck.
area.buildings.3.title: Two-flat or condo
area.buildings.3.body: A shared boiler, or a furnace per unit after conversion. Condensers off the alley or on the garage.
area.buildings.4.title: Shop or restaurant
area.buildings.4.body: Rooftop units and make-up air on Damen and North, scheduled around opening hours.

area.faq.heading: Bucktown HVAC, answered
area.faq.1.q: Does a high-efficiency furnace need replacing when it stops working?
area.faq.1.a: Often not. The fault is often a sensor, igniter or blocked drain line. We diagnose first, and where the furnace has years left, we say so.
area.faq.2.q: How far is your shop from Bucktown?
area.faq.3.q: My house has a system on each floor. Can you look at both on one visit?
area.faq.4.q: Does HVAC repair in Chicago need a permit?
area.cta.body: Have the make of your furnace or condenser to hand, and tell us what it's doing. If the condenser is on a roof deck, mention how we get up to it.

extras.districts.4.hvac: HVAC here: furnaces and central air in townhomes, splits in condos.
extras.faq.2.a: Under a mile. The shop is at 1225 N Cleaver St in West Town, just south-east of Bucktown across The 606, and Rob runs the calls from there.
extras.faq.3.a: Yes. Tell us when you call that there's a system on each floor, so we know to check both.
extras.faq.4.a: No. Chicago doesn't require a permit to repair, diagnose or maintain heating and cooling. Permits cover installs and construction, so a company's permit count says little about its repair work.
extras.faq.5.a: Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday, 6:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Call (773) 238-3838.
